scenes.heading: Choosing and maintaining your core gear kit

sents.d: Choosing and maintaining your core gear kit
The right gear list matters less than knowing your kit inside out.

scenes.heading: Know a small kit extremely well

sents.d: New videographers often chase the newest camera body, but consistent, reliable results usually come from knowing a smaller kit extremely well rather than owning the latest equipment.

A practical starting kit typically includes one reliable camera body, two or three versatile lenses, an external microphone for clean audio, a basic lighting setup, and enough storage and batteries to get through a full shoot day without stopping.

Build in redundancy before adding variety — a backup battery and a spare card matter more than a third lens, since a single point of failure can end a shoot entirely, while a limited lens selection rarely does.

take: Master a small, reliable kit and always carry backups.
